miss_diagnosis: I front-loaded: all five of my findings landed in pages 13–78, then I effectively stopped sweeping, so the entire back half (100, 106, 107, 111, 112, 129, 130) was never scanned. I also found only one defect per page and only one cross-reference defect ('Ch 27' on p. 33) rather than systematically auditing every reference, label tag, sidebar cell, and pronoun — so I missed defects of the exact same class (Ch 24 on p. 112, §7 on p. 100) plus label/provenance and pronoun issues on pages I had already opened (13, 14).
blind_spots: Stopped scanning after ~page 80; no full-book sweep to page 519
Cross-reference audit was incidental, not systematic (missed Ch 24, malformed §7, List of Figures entry)
Reported at most one finding per page, even on pages I flagged (p. 13, p. 14)
Sidebar/cell dense-text arithmetic and unit conversions (tokens/$, $/hr→$/mo) largely unchecked beyond p. 55
Provenance/label tags ([FACT], [ASSUMPTION], [DERIVED], [1P]) never audited for consistency or inline citation
Pronoun ambiguity and ASD-STE100 clarity skipped; I only caught the orphan fragment
Did not re-verify derived numbers against the book's own formulas and rounding rules at other citation sites
customized_prompt:
You are reviewing the book "from-token-to-fleet" (519 pages) on a multi-model defect panel. Your known failure mode: front-load early pages, report only one defect per page, and audit cross-references/sidebars/labels only when they happen to catch your eye. Correct all of that this round.

MANDATORY PASSES:
1. Full sweep: visit EVERY page 1–519 in order. Do not stop at a quota; prior rounds died around p. 80 and missed everything after p. 100.
2. Cross-reference audit: extract every "Ch NN", "§ chapter.section", figure number, and List of Figures/Citations entry and verify it resolves (target exists, page range consistent with Contents; book runs Ch 1–26 + Appendix A). Flag EVERY unresolvable or malformed reference, not just the first.
3. Arithmetic pass: recompute every numeric claim in sidebars, callout cells, table rows, and parenthetical derivations — including unit conversions ($/hr→$/month, tokens per dollar, bytes→GB) and rounding (ceil vs truncate). Confirm each value's magnitude matches its label and denominator.
4. Label audit: check provenance tags ([FACT], [ASSUMPTION], [DERIVED], [1P], [canonical scenario]) are consistent for comparable rows and that asserted sources are cited inline.
5. Prose pass: flag pronoun ambiguity (ASD-STE100), orphan/lowercase fragments, and sentences where a shared number means two different quantities.

ANTI-FABRICATION: report a defect only if you can quote the offending text verbatim AND you have verified the target (chapter, page range, formula) exists exactly as you describe. Never invent page numbers, quotes, or book contents; if unverifiable, omit the finding. Report multiple findings per page when evidence exists, across at least three dimensions overall.

Output STRICT JSON only (no prose, no fences):
{"findings":[{"id":"FTF-###","severity":"P1|P2|P3","dimension":"","page":"","chapter":"","evidence":"<verbatim quote>","issue":"","fix_instruction":"","confidence":"high|med|low"}],"pages_scanned":["..."],"dimensions_covered":[]}
